findings.reason: the plan's own readiness signal and its dispatch authority say go while its content says stop, so a node's dispatch is spent on work the plan has already established it cannot run.
findings.text: the driving followup `f-tfnsis-001` schedules §5 after §4 with no mention that §5 cannot be dispatched until the lead chooses a route, while §5 itself (line 313, added in 1fb558c1a) says "§5 is not dispatched until that choice is made" and the section still declares `data-status="implementable"`; a coordinator dispatching from the followup repeats the launch refusal already recorded in comment `c-s5-authority` (2026-10-19 05:47)

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — every anchor in the changed units resolves: `checkout_trust.py:707` (`reckon_imports`), `checkout_trust.py:389`, `checkout_trust.py:344`, `crew_follow_commands.py:221` (the retry-gap constant), `follower_registration.py:444`, `dispatch_admission.py:1773`, and `fleet_migrate.py:708–716 / 722–734 / 768–773`; the gate evidence href now names an existing fragment file.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — each changed section declares a measurable negative control (§5's probe with a recorded tab removed before the check, which must be refused; §11's materialised tree carrying a module that fails to import), and §11's measurement carries a base-revision positive control (sixteen probes at base, one at the change).
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — no changed unit directs evidence to a scratchpad or a node-local temporary directory; the corrected gate href and §2's done-when both land under `docs/evidence/fragments/the-fleet-node-stays-in-service/`, which exists.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the changed prose carries no plan labels, stage names, ticket numbers or version tags, and no changelog prose beyond the mechanism it states.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — §11's root cause matches its cited evidence (63 first-parent moves of `reckon/` or `skills/` on main in 24 h, checked against `git log --first-parent`), its mechanism (one recorded verdict per materialised tree, serialised by an exclusive lock) produces the measure it asserts (one probe for sixteen askers), and the caller is named and real (`reckon_imports`, reached from `crew_follow_commands.py:329`).
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §5 carries one deliverable (a rehearsal of the current head) and §11 one (one import proof per materialised tree); neither is a bundle of independent changes.
rubric_items.wiring: a finding — §5 still declares `data-status="implementable"` and the driving followup `f-tfnsis-001` schedules it ("§5 follows §4") with no mention that §5 cannot be dispatched until the lead chooses a route, though §5's own closing paragraph (line 313) says "§5 is not dispatched until that choice is made".
